stem: Mrs. Williams borrowed $6,000 from a bank to pay for some home repairs. She paid $7,500 back to the bank. Which of these is the most likely reason Mrs. Williams paid the bank more than the amount she borrowed?

options.label: A
options.text: She made a mistake in calculating the amount she needed to pay back.

options.label: B
options.text: She actually needed more than $6,000 for the home repairs.

options.label: C
options.text: She had to pay interest on the amount of money she borrowed.

options.label: D
options.text: She had to pay sales tax on the amount of money she borrowed.

difficulty_rationale: The problem requires understanding of borrowing money and the concept of paying interest, distinguishing it from mistakes or other reasons for paying more.
